rules.name: API edge 5xx ratio (10 min)
rules.query: [{"refId":"A","queryType":"","relativeTimeRange":{"from":600,"to":0},"datasourceUid":"ch-k8s-prod","model":{"datasource":{"type":"grafana-clickhouse-datasource","uid":"ch-k8s-prod"},"editorType":"sql","format":1,"intervalMs":1000,"maxDataPoints":43200,"rawSql":"SELECT if(e \u003e= 20 AND e * 20 \u003e= total, e, 0) AS errors_5xx FROM (SELECT countIf(status \u003e= 500 AND NOT ((status = 503 AND err_cls IN ('device_offline', 'desktop_offline', 'no_device_online', 'device_gone', 'mac_offline')) OR (method = 'POST' AND status = 503 AND match(path, '^/(v1/)?(device/pair|device-race|session/resolve|github/api)$')))) AS e, count() AS total FROM api.http_events WHERE ts \u003e now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND NOT startsWith(path, '/webhooks/'))","refId":"A"}},{"refId":"B","queryType":"","relativeTimeRange":{"from":0,"to":0},"datasourceUid":"__expr__","model":{"datasource":{"type":"__expr__","uid":"__expr__"},"expression":"A","intervalMs":1000,"maxDataPoints":43200,"reducer":"last","refId":"B","settings":{"mode":"dropNN"},"type":"reduce"}},{"refId":"C","queryType":"","relativeTimeRange":{"from":0,"to":0},"datasourceUid":"__expr__","model":{"conditions":[{"evaluator":{"params":[0],"type":"gt"},"operator":{"type":"and"},"query":{"params":["C"]},"reducer":{"params":[],"type":"last"},"type":"query"}],"datasource":{"type":"__expr__","uid":"__expr__"},"expression":"B","intervalMs":1000,"maxDataPoints":43200,"refId":"C","type":"threshold"}}]

annotations.description: At least 20 responses with status >= 500, and at least 5% of the requests in the last 10 minutes of api.http_events. Every 503 that says the user's own device is away (err_cls device_offline: an asleep desktop or an offline Mac, a designed transient answer; and POST /device/pair, device race, session resolve and the GitHub lane, which answer 503 for nothing else) and all /webhooks/ paths are left out (the latter have their own rule). Group them: SELECT path, status, count() FROM api.http_events WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND status >= 500 GROUP BY path, status ORDER BY 3 DESC.
annotations.summary: Edge 5xx: {{ $values.B }} errors in 10 minutes, at least 5% of requests

annotations.description: At least 20 responses with status >= 500, and at least 5% of the requests in the last 10 minutes of api.http_events. Group them: SELECT path, status, count() FROM api.http_events WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND status >= 500 GROUP BY path, status ORDER BY 3 DESC.

annotations.description: api.http_events has no row newer than 5 minutes, or ClickHouse did not answer this query. The edge writes one row per request, so a quiet window means no traffic or a broken path (the prod edge, its ClickHouse sink or ClickHouse itself), so zero means the edge, its ClickHouse sink or ClickHouse itself is down. A planned edge recreate stays inside the 5 minutes + 2 minutes of grace.

rules.query: [{"refId":"A","queryType":"","relativeTimeRange":{"from":600,"to":0},"datasourceUid":"ch-k8s-prod","model":{"datasource":{"type":"grafana-clickhouse-datasource","uid":"ch-k8s-prod"},"editorType":"sql","format":1,"intervalMs":1000,"maxDataPoints":43200,"rawSql":"SELECT starts, start_stuck FROM (SELECT count() AS starts, concat(pool, ': start_timeout') AS start_stuck FROM api.cloud_device_starts WHERE ts \u003e now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE AND stage = 'start_timeout' GROUP BY pool UNION ALL SELECT requested AS starts, concat(pool, ': requested, no live') AS start_stuck FROM (SELECT pool, countIf(stage = 'requested') AS requested, countIf(stage = 'live') AS live FROM api.cloud_device_starts WHERE ts \u003e now() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE GROUP BY pool HAVING requested \u003e= 3 AND live = 0))","refId":"A"}},{"refId":"B","queryType":"","relativeTimeRange":{"from":0,"to":0},"datasourceUid":"__expr__","model":{"datasource":{"type":"__expr__","uid":"__expr__"},"expression":"A","intervalMs":1000,"maxDataPoints":43200,"reducer":"last","refId":"B","settings":{"mode":"dropNN"},"type":"reduce"}},{"refId":"C","queryType":"","relativeTimeRange":{"from":0,"to":0},"datasourceUid":"__expr__","model":{"conditions":[{"evaluator":{"params":[0],"type":"gt"},"operator":{"type":"and"},"query":{"params":["C"]},"reducer":{"params":[],"type":"last"},"type":"query"}],"datasource":{"type":"__expr__","uid":"__expr__"},"expression":"B","intervalMs":1000,"maxDataPoints":43200,"refId":"C","type":"threshold"}}]

annotations.description: Either a pool has a start_timeout row in the last 15 minutes (a caller waited out its 30 s start budget with no live device), or a pool has 3 or more requested rows and no live row in the last 30 minutes. The label names the pool and the reason. A restore (restore_from_backup = 1) that outlives its caller writes start_timeout too; a warm start with no waiting caller writes only requested rows. Read the rows: SELECT ts, user_id, stage, tier, runner_node, restore_from_backup, error_class, ms_since_request FROM api.cloud_device_starts WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE AND pool = <the pool in the label> ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50. Dashboard: api-cloud. No data does not page; a query error pages (execErr Alerting).

rules.name: API vendor credit: a platform key is refusing
rules.query:
[{"refId":"A","queryType":"","relativeTimeRange":{"from":600,"to":0},"datasourceUid":"ch-k8s-prod","model":{"datasource":{"type":"grafana-clickhouse-datasource","uid":"ch-k8s-prod"},"editorType":"sql","format":1,"intervalMs":1000,"maxDataPoints":43200,"rawSql":"SELECT vendor, uniqExact(request) AS refusals FROM (SELECT ts, 'turn reply' AS source, multiIf(match(assistant_reply, '(?i)openai|gpt-image|chatgpt|codex'), 'openai',
      match(assistant_reply, '(?i)gemini|generativelanguage|vertex|codeassist|aistudio'), 'gemini',
      match(assistant_reply, '(?i)anthropic|claude'), 'anthropic',
      match(assistant_reply, '(?i)\\bxai\\b|x\\.ai|grok'), 'xai',
      match(assistant_reply, '(?i)modelhub'), 'modelhub',
      match(assistant_reply, '(?i)\\bfal\\b|fal\\.ai|fal-ai|fal_ai'), 'fal',
      match(assistant_reply, '(?i)voiceco|voice[ _]co'), 'voiceco',
      match(assistant_reply, '(?i)speechco'), 'speechco',
      match(assistant_reply, '(?i)assembly[ _-]?ai'), 'assemblyai',
      match(assistant_reply, '(?i)telnyx'), 'telnyx',
      match(assistant_reply, '(?i)meshco'), 'meshco',
      match(assistant_reply, '(?i)shapeco'), 'shapeco',
      match(assistant_reply, '(?i)duffel'), 'duffel',
      match(assistant_reply, '(?i)typesafe'), 'typesafe',
      match(assistant_reply, '(?i)cloudflare[ _-]?(?:calls|turn|realtime)|rtc\\.live\\.cloudflare'), 'cloudflare',
      match(assistant_reply, '(?i)smithery'), 'smithery',
      match(assistant_reply, '(?i)\\byelp\\b'), 'yelp',
      match(assistant_reply, '(?i)firecrawl'), 'firecrawl',
      match(assistant_reply, '(?i)resend\\.com|resend[ _]api|\\bresend:'), 'resend',
      match(assistant_reply, '(?i)gateway'), 'gateway',
      match(assistant_reply, '(?i)\\brouter\\b|api-router'), 'router',
      match(assistant_reply, '(?i)embedding'), 'embeddings',
      'other') AS vendor, 'platform' AS lane,
      if(extract(assistant_reply, '(?i)"error"\\s*:\\s*"([a-z][a-z0-9 _.-]{2,40}?) failed') != '', extract(assistant_reply, '(?i)"error"\\s*:\\s*"([a-z][a-z0-9 _.-]{2,40}?) failed'), if(gen_ai_response_model != '', gen_ai_response_model, gen_ai_request_model)) AS target,
      toString(status) AS status, request_id_s AS request, assistant_reply AS detail
    FROM app_telemetry.request_conversations
    WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE AND match(assistant_reply, '(?i)"(?:error|reason|message)"\\s*:\\s*"(?:[^"\\\\]|\\\\.)*(?:insufficient_quota|credit_balance_exhausted|billing_hard_limit|billing_error|billing_not_configured|vendor_billing_refused|no_credits|quota_exceeded|nomorecredits|insufficient_credits|insufficient_balance|payment_required|no credits|insufficient credits?|insufficient (?:funds|balance)|credit balance|out of credits|not enough credits?|(?:do not|does not|don.t|doesn.t) have (?:any|enough) credits?|used all available credits|credits?[ _-]?(?:exhausted|depleted)|requires more credits|prepayment credits|exceeded your (?:current )?quota|payment required|spending limit|exhausted balance|user is locked|(?:http|status)\\D{0,8}402\\b)')
  UNION ALL
    SELECT ts, 'model call' AS source, multiIf(match(concat(error, ' ', adapter, ' ', model), '(?i)openai|gpt-image|chatgpt|codex'), 'openai',
      match(concat(error, ' ', adapter, ' ', model), '(?i)gemini|generativelanguage|vertex|codeassist|aistudio'), 'gemini',
      match(concat(error, ' ', adapter, ' ', model), '(?i)anthropic|claude'), 'anthropic',
      match(concat(error, ' ', adapter, ' ', model), '(?i)\\bxai\\b|x\\.ai|grok'), 'xai',
      match(concat(error, ' ', adapter, ' ', model), '(?i)modelhub'), 'modelhub',
      match(concat(error, ' ', adapter, ' ', model), '(?i)\\bfal\\b|fal\\.ai|fal-ai|fal_ai'), 'fal',
      match(concat(error, ' ', adapter, ' ', model), '(?i)voiceco|voice[ _]co'), 'voiceco',
      match(concat(error, ' ', adapter, ' ', model), '(?i)speechco'), 'speechco',
      match(concat(error, ' ', adapter, ' ', model), '(?i)assembly[ _-]?ai'), 'assemblyai',
      match(concat(error, ' ', adapter, ' ', model), '(?i)telnyx'), 'telnyx',
      match(concat(error, ' ', adapter, ' ', model), '(?i)meshco'), 'meshco',
      match(concat(error, ' ', adapter, ' ', model), '(?i)shapeco'), 'shapeco',
      match(concat(error, ' ', adapter, ' ', model), '(?i)duffel'), 'duffel',
      match(concat(error, ' ', adapter, ' ', model), '(?i)typesafe'), 'typesafe',
      match(concat(error, ' ', adapter, ' ', model), '(?i)cloudflare[ _-]?(?:calls|turn|realtime)|rtc\\.live\\.cloudflare'), 'cloudflare',
      match(concat(error, ' ', adapter, ' ', model), '(?i)smithery'), 'smithery',
      match(concat(error, ' ', adapter, ' ', model), '(?i)\\byelp\\b'), 'yelp',
      match(concat(error, ' ', adapter, ' ', model), '(?i)firecrawl'), 'firecrawl',
      match(concat(error, ' ', adapter, ' ', model), '(?i)resend\\.com|resend[ _]api|\\bresend:'), 'resend',
      match(concat(error, ' ', adapter, ' ', model), '(?i)gateway'), 'gateway',
      match(concat(error, ' ', adapter, ' ', model), '(?i)\\brouter\\b|api-router'), 'router',
      match(concat(error, ' ', adapter, ' ', model), '(?i)embedding'), 'embeddings',
      'other') AS vendor,
      multiIf(kind = 'device', 'device', startsWith(model, 'harness/byo:'), 'byo', 'platform') AS lane,
      if(adapter != '', adapter, model) AS target, toString(status) AS status, request_id AS request, error AS detail
    FROM api.llm_calls
    WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE AND match(error, '(?i)(?:insufficient_quota|credit_balance_exhausted|billing_hard_limit|billing_error|billing_not_configured|vendor_billing_refused|no_credits|quota_exceeded|nomorecredits|insufficient_credits|insufficient_balance|payment_required|no credits|insufficient credits?|insufficient (?:funds|balance)|credit balance|out of credits|not enough credits?|(?:do not|does not|don.t|doesn.t) have (?:any|enough) credits?|used all available credits|credits?[ _-]?(?:exhausted|depleted)|requires more credits|prepayment credits|exceeded your (?:current )?quota|payment required|spending limit|exhausted balance|user is locked|(?:http|status)\\D{0,8}402\\b)')
